import pandas as pd
file_path = '/data/sahyog_budget_and_receipts.xlsx'
df_raw = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='Finance FY25-26', header=None)

# Approved budget
# Header row at index 4, data rows 5 to 16
approved_rows = df_raw.iloc[5:17]  # 5 inclusive to 16 inclusive
# Columns: 4 is Approved Budget (INR)
approved_budget_vals = pd.to_numeric(approved_rows[4], errors='coerce')
total_approved = approved_budget_vals.sum()
print("Approved rows count:", len(approved_budget_vals))
print("Total approved budget:", total_approved)

# Receipts
# Header row at index 22, data rows 23 to 48
receipts_rows = df_raw.iloc[23:49]  # 23 to 48 inclusive
# Column 5 is Amount Received (INR)
receipt_amount_vals = pd.to_numeric(receipts_rows[5], errors='coerce')
total_receipts = receipt_amount_vals.sum()
print("Receipt rows count:", len(receipt_amount_vals))
print("Total receipts:", total_receipts)

percentage = 100 * total_receipts / total_approved if total_approved else None
print("Percentage:", percentage)
